title: What PTAs Do
description: Physical therapist assistants deliver the hands-on treatment in the physical therapist's plan of care: therapeutic exercise, gait and balance training, manual therapy, modalities like ultrasound and e-stim, and patient education. They work in outpatient clinics, hospitals, nursing homes, and home health — the coaches of recovery.

title: A Day in the Life
description: PTAs run 30- to 60-minute sessions back to back: reviewing the plan, warming up the patient, guiding exercises with constant cueing, progressing difficulty as tolerated, and documenting.
